# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

# Let Us Help You Choose a Plan

Take the guesswork out of picking a health plan. Answer a few questions to get a personalized
recommendation.

[ Get started . Opens in new window ][145]

New member? [Register now][146], or download the [Sydney Health app][147] to access your benefits,
ID card, pharmacy info, and more.

[Understand your care options][148] ahead of time so you can save time and money.

**Medicaid members:** New federal rules may affect your health coverage. [Learn more and stay
covered][149].

## Our Plans

#### Individual & Family Plans

We offer affordable health, dental, and vision coverage to fit your budget. Plus, you may qualify
for financial help to lower your health coverage costs.

Shop Plans
[ Overview ][150]

#### Medicare Plans

Find a Medicare plan that fits your healthcare needs and your budget. Compare plans available in
your area and apply today.

Shop Plans
[ Overview ][151]

#### Medicaid Plans

We offer low-cost coverage for children, adults, and families who qualify for state-sponsored
programs. Explore programs available in your state.

[ More About Medicaid Plans ][152]

#### Small Business Plans

Our small business plans offer a full range of health insurance options for groups with 2 to 50 or
100 employees, depending on your state.

[ More About Small Business Plans ][153]

## Let Us Help You Choose A Health Plan

Not sure what plan is right for you? We can help. Just answer a few questions.

[ Find your plan ][154]

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Leading the future of sustainable farming

### Operating at the forefront of agricultural science to provide farmers and growers with naturally
### derived products for excellent crop protection, whilst minimising harm to the environment and
### maintaining a sustainable ecosystem.

## Innovative, evidence-based products for a better tomorrow, today

Solving real world issues with advanced and new technologies, while:
* Reducing the mounting unsustainable pressure on the land
* Restoring the critical balance between agriculture and nature
* Meeting the challenging requirements of the rapidly evolving food production market

## Solutions

Our pioneering biological crop protection tools give farmers and growers the confidence they need to
grow strong, healthy crops; food production that is more sustainable with a reduced environmental
impact.

Underpinned by scientific research and rigorous testing, our products have levels of efficacy
comparable to conventional market solutions.

We are committed to revolutionising the market by delivering ready-to-use green alternatives for the
modern-day farmer and grower, including:
* BioInsecticides
* BioFungicides
* BioHerbicides and desiccants
* Biostimulants

[Find out more][25]

## Robust and trailblazing science

With a progressive research and development platform, AlphaBio has a pipeline of forward-looking
products with safeguarding our biodiversity a key prerequisite in our thinking.

Every innovation from AlphaBio is driven by a mission to deliver highly efficient biocontrol tools
that look after our precious natural environment.

[Find out more][26]

## About us

Farming is making massive strides towards restoring the critical balance between agriculture and
nature, which will eventually allow the planet and global food supply to thrive. We are not there
yet but we are optimistic and determined to play a leading role in this vital change of direction.

[Find out more][27]
[Combine harvester]

> “Nature can be harnessed to help protect what we grow.”

> “The holy grail of insecticides is to be bee and environmentally friendly. AlphaBio may have
> discovered it.”
> Green Apple Judges, awarding AlphaBio Control the Silver Award for Environmental Best Practice

# Leading the future of sustainable farming

### Operating at the forefront of agricultural science to provide farmers and growers with naturally
### derived products for excellent crop protection, whilst minimising harm to the environment and
### maintaining a sustainable ecosystem.

## Innovative, evidence-based products for a better tomorrow, today

Solving real world issues with advanced and new technologies, while:
* Reducing the mounting unsustainable pressure on the land
* Restoring the critical balance between agriculture and nature
* Meeting the challenging requirements of the rapidly evolving food production market

## Solutions

Our pioneering biological crop protection tools give farmers and growers the confidence they need to
grow strong, healthy crops; food production that is more sustainable with a reduced environmental
impact.

Underpinned by scientific research and rigorous testing, our products have levels of efficacy
comparable to conventional market solutions.

We are committed to revolutionising the market by delivering ready-to-use green alternatives for the
modern-day farmer and grower, including:
* BioInsecticides
* BioFungicides
* BioHerbicides and desiccants
* Biostimulants

[Find out more][25]

## Robust and trailblazing science

With a progressive research and development platform, AlphaBio has a pipeline of forward-looking
products with safeguarding our biodiversity a key prerequisite in our thinking.

Every innovation from AlphaBio is driven by a mission to deliver highly efficient biocontrol tools
that look after our precious natural environment.

[Find out more][26]

## About us

Farming is making massive strides towards restoring the critical balance between agriculture and
nature, which will eventually allow the planet and global food supply to thrive. We are not there
yet but we are optimistic and determined to play a leading role in this vital change of direction.

[Find out more][27]
[Combine harvester]

> “Nature can be harnessed to help protect what we grow.”

> “The holy grail of insecticides is to be bee and environmentally friendly. AlphaBio may have
> discovered it.”
> Green Apple Judges, awarding AlphaBio Control the Silver Award for Environmental Best Practice

## How It Works?
* Pain happens when your receptors send a signal from your spine to your brain. Cold sensations,
  like menthol, stimulate receptors to block those signals to relieve pain.
* The fast acting, menthol based formula of Biofreeze provides you powerful pain relief when
  directly applied to the skin.

[Learn more about our formula][30]

* Pain happens when your receptors send a signal from your spine to your brain. Cold sensations,
  like menthol, stimulate receptors to block those signals to relieve pain.
* The fast acting, menthol based formula of Biofreeze provides you powerful pain relief when
  directly applied to the skin.

## Chicago’s Local Medical Home Healthcare Agency for Seniors

At Essential Home Health Care, we are committed to being Chicagoland’s top choice for senior and
elder care. We understand the challenges that come with ensuring your loved ones receive the best
possible care, especially when they wish to maintain their independence at home. Our agency
specializes in providing compassionate, personalized services tailored to the unique needs of older
adults. Whether your loved one requires physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, or
post-surgical care, our dedicated team is here to support them every step of the way.

We recognize that adult children often play a crucial role in coordinating care for their aging
parents. That’s why we work closely with families to create customized care plans that promote
health, safety, and peace of mind. With Essential Home Health Care, you can trust that your loved
ones are receiving expert care that respects their dignity and enhances their quality of life—all in
the comfort of their own home.

### Non- Medical Home Care & Home Health Aide Services

It is important to note that Essential is not a home care or home maker agency, but a medical
healthcare agency.  We provide nursing and therapy primarily through medicare insurance.

## Our Mission

To assist our clients in maintaining a safe and healthy home environment conductive to achieving the
highest level of functional independence in the comfort of their homes.

## Chicago’s Local Medical Home Healthcare Agency for Seniors

At Essential Home Health Care, we are committed to being Chicagoland’s top choice for senior and
elder care. We understand the challenges that come with ensuring your loved ones receive the best
possible care, especially when they wish to maintain their independence at home. Our agency
specializes in providing compassionate, personalized services tailored to the unique needs of older
adults. Whether your loved one requires physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, or
post-surgical care, our dedicated team is here to support them every step of the way.

We recognize that adult children often play a crucial role in coordinating care for their aging
parents. That’s why we work closely with families to create customized care plans that promote
health, safety, and peace of mind. With Essential Home Health Care, you can trust that your loved
ones are receiving expert care that respects their dignity and enhances their quality of life—all in
the comfort of their own home.

### Non- Medical Home Care & Home Health Aide Services

It is important to note that Essential is not a home care or home maker agency, but a medical
healthcare agency.  We provide nursing and therapy primarily through medicare insurance.

## Our Mission

To assist our clients in maintaining a safe and healthy home environment conductive to achieving the
highest level of functional independence in the comfort of their homes.

## Change Your Life with


## Hypnosis ..!


Weight Loss, Stop Smoking, Anxiety, Stress, Procrastination, Phobias - HabitsBeGone can help through
Hypnosis.

 

Easy, Effortless, Safe - let me help you get rid of those bad habits, develop good habits and
motivate you in all areas of your personal and business life!

## Hypno Facts!

 
* At HabitsBeGone.com when hypnotized you will be fully aware of what is going on and remain in
  complete control.  

 
* All hypnosis is self-hypnosis and in order to benefit you need to be willing to truly want the
  changes you are seeking!  Your Hypnotists is your guide to personal development.

* Certified Hypnotists are professionally trained to guide people on a personal and corporate level
  to make positive changes in all areas of their life. 

 
* Typically clients want to be able to either "do something they are not currently able to do" or
  "stop doing something they are currently doing and don't want to do".

 
* Each person and each case is different as is each issue ... 

 
* Anyone can be hypnotized if they want to be and are willing.

 
* Hypnosis is a natural state of mind and each of us are hypnotized numerous times throughout the
  day, for example ... any time you get engrossed in driving your car, reading book, watching a
  movie or just simply day dreaming, all are a form of hypnosis!

to help many people with many different issues.

 

Gary Barone

# Creating Connected Communities

Enabling all people in the Bailiwick of Guernsey (Guernsey, Alderney, Sark and Herm) to be connected
to the support that matters to them, through our service offerings and signposting support. Find out
more below.

[Explore][27]
[Volunteer][28]
[Four friends laughing and smiling while looking at the Community Directory on a phone. They are
wearing walking gear and are outside on a footpath with trees behind them. ]

## Our support for you

We want to make sure that everyone can find and connect to the support they need for their health
and wellbeing. We offer services and signposting to connect you to what matters most:

[
[1.png]
][29]

### Community
### Directory

A helpful guide to local groups and services, making it easier to find the support that matters to
your health and wellbeing. 

[Explore ][30]
[
[3.png]
][31]

### Signposting
### Support

A one-to-one signposting service, helping to connect people to the community support listed on our
directory.

[Learn more ][32]
[
[6.png]
][33]

### Talking
### Cafés

In-person connection and signposting support for those who need it most. Attendees also meet new
people, make new friends and connect them with the services that matter most.

[Learn more ][34]
[
[4.png]
][35]

### Transport
### Service

Reliable and compassionate volunteer drivers assist with transport, access to medical appointments
and health and wellbeing support.

[Learn more ][36]
[
[5.png]
][37]

### Off-Island
### Support

A one-to-one support and information service for people receiving treatment and care off-island,
offering printed or digital hospital packs to help guide people and their families through this
experience.

[Learn more ][38]
[
[2.png]
][39]

### Charity
### Shop

Our charity shop/s are key to our self-sufficiency and sustainability efforts. They support both our
services and the community, while providing affordable options for many of our customers and service
users.

[Learn more ][40]

### Our impact

655

Directory listings

Our community support directory strengthens connections by improving awareness and access to
statutory, private, third-sector, and community resources.

6212

Journeys delivered in 2025

We are delighted to have 39 volunteer drivers who provide a safe, reliable and caring service,
ensuring people remain connected to the support that matters to them.

3526

People Signposted to support in 2025

## Why Choose the Institute for your Massage Therapy Continuing Education?

### Largest Selection of Massage Therapy Continuing Education Courses

Choose from the largest massage therapy continuing education course library on the web with 150+
home study massage CEU courses. The Institute is approved by the NCBTMB as a CE Approved Provider.
Many of our CE courses are also accepted by ABMP, AMTA, and most state boards. All courses come with
our 90-day 100% Money Back Guarantee. You're guaranteed to find massage therapy courses that will
expand your skills, meet your needs, and pique your interests.

### Our Course Options Allow You to Study in the Format that Best Suits You

You can choose physical texts, DVDs, and testing materials, or have them made available to you fully
online or a combination there of. If you have a tight deadline, we offer you 24/7 access to over 100
completely online massage therapy courses. With this option, you have immediate access to your
materials through our secure online course center. You take your test online when you're ready. You
get your test results immediately and instantly print your certificate upon passing.

### Relax and Enjoy Our Materials for Years

Whether you choose to receive your materials by mail or online, you'll be able to reference your
materials as often as you like and for as long as you like.

### We Take the Stress Out of Your Massage Therapy Continuing Education

Our knowledgeable and friendly course advisors are experts in NCBTMB, AMTA, ABMP and state board
massage CEU requirements, can make course recommendations, answer any course related questions, and
help you every step of the way from selecting courses to receiving your certificates. They are so
well informed and responsive that we actually have massage therapists call us instead of the NCBTMB
to answer questions.

### Industry-Leading Free Newsletter

In addition to our amazing massage CEU courses, we also provide a leading massage industry
newsletter, Massage Professionals Update, where you can keep up with the latest massage news, and
receive tips on how to improve your client sessions, grow your business, and so much more. [Sign up
today][22].

## A Welcome from Dr. Brian Mayrsohn, Founder of Maywell Pain Management Practice

As a comprehensive pain management physician, Dr. Mayrsohn is dedicated to enhancing the lives of
his patients through a [holistic and cutting-edge approach to pain management][93]. With a profound
commitment to patient well-being, Dr. Brian Mayrsohn is compassionate and patient-centered, with a
primary focus on improving patient function and facilitating the ability to enjoy life. His practice
effectively blends the best of cutting-edge clinical medicine with complementary therapies such as
[nutrition][94], psychotherapy, physical therapy, [acupuncture][95], and [chiropractic
medicine][96], setting a new standard in comprehensive pain care.

Innovative Integrative Approach: Dr. Mayrsohn is at the forefront of his field, consistently seeking
out and incorporating the latest advancements in pain management procedures. His unwavering
dedication to researching and utilizing innovative medical breakthroughs safeguards his patients
with the most effective, evidence-based treatments available.

[Learn more][97]

## A Welcome from Dr. Brian Mayrsohn, Founder of Maywell Pain Management Practice

As a comprehensive pain management physician, Dr. Mayrsohn is dedicated to enhancing the lives of
his patients through a [holistic and cutting-edge approach to pain management][93]. With a profound
commitment to patient well-being, Dr. Brian Mayrsohn is compassionate and patient-centered, with a
primary focus on improving patient function and facilitating the ability to enjoy life. His practice
effectively blends the best of cutting-edge clinical medicine with complementary therapies such as
[nutrition][94], psychotherapy, physical therapy, [acupuncture][95], and [chiropractic
medicine][96], setting a new standard in comprehensive pain care.

Innovative Integrative Approach: Dr. Mayrsohn is at the forefront of his field, consistently seeking
out and incorporating the latest advancements in pain management procedures. His unwavering
dedication to researching and utilizing innovative medical breakthroughs safeguards his patients
with the most effective, evidence-based treatments available.

[Learn more][97]

  ****While fevers are common in young children, the very first time a baby has a fever can be

* ### ****[Common Causes of aches and Pains][28]****
  
  ****Whether you’re 18 or 80, most of us have experienced aches and pains. It can be clear where
  some of them come from, like back pain and period pain. However, sometimes we get aches and pains
  that don’t seem to have an obvious source. Learning more about what...****

## ******Why Nurofen?******
* ****Nurofen’s success is the result of over **30 years** of research and development. We are
  experienced in pain relief, and we are here to help****
* ****Nurofen contains ibuprofen which has **anti-inflammatory properties to help ****relieve pain
  at the source by reducing inflammation******
* ****Nurofen **does not need to be taken with food******

# Advanced Pain Management Solution In The Woodlands

Pain MD Houston are experts in the latest and most comprehensive pain management treatment therapies
to help patients at all stages and with all types of complex, acute, and chronic pain.

[Dr. Mukalel][158] is dedicated to finding solutions for your pain syndromes. Having already
completed a fellowship in Acute Pain Medicine in Pittsburg, as well as having been the Director of
the University of Texas at Houston’s Orthopedic Anesthesia, Acute Pain Service and Fellowship in
Acute Pain and Regional Anesthesia as well as the Bayfront Health System’s Chief of Pain Medicine
and Obstetrical Anesthesia

# Your Path to Living Pain Free

Led by board-certified pain management doctor, Dr. Syed. our team offers comprehensive pain care.

Pain can feel overwhelming, but there is hope for relief. Pain management physicians are dedicated
to helping people overcome pain and live their best lives.
By combining medical expertise with a compassionate approach, they can develop a personalized
treatment plan to address your specific needs.

From simple lifestyle changes to advanced medical interventions, we’re committed
to helping you find the path to a pain-free future.

Complete our free pain questionnaire to find out if you are a candidate for our treatments.

Welcome to the Pain Treatment Institute

# Your Path to Living Pain Free

Led by board-certified pain management doctor, Dr. Syed. our team offers comprehensive pain care.

Pain can feel overwhelming, but there is hope for relief. Pain management physicians are dedicated
to helping people overcome pain and live their best lives.
By combining medical expertise with a compassionate approach, they can develop a personalized
treatment plan to address your specific needs.

From simple lifestyle changes to advanced medical interventions, we’re committed
to helping you find the path to a pain-free future.

Complete our free pain questionnaire to find out if you are a candidate for our treatments.

### Back Pain

Back pain can be treated with a number of different procedures. Depending on the location, source,
and severity of your back pain, some of the procedures we use are:

Medication
Physiotherapy
Nerve block
Epidural steroid injection
Spinal cord stimulator
Radio frequency
Pain pumps
[ Read More ][161]

### Hip Pain

At the Pain Treatment Institute, our pain management physicians look for conservative, non-surgical
treatment options first. Our pain management physicians will complete an evaluation of the hip joint
to determine the best treatment. Some treatment options could be:
Rest
Ice and heat intervals
Stretching
Regenerative treatments
Injections
Anti-Inflammatory medicine

### Georgia’s Most Trusted Rehabilitation & Back Pain Specialists

## Welcome to Southern Pain and Spine

Pain is personal. Our goal is to understand your pain and develop a customized treatment plan to
relieve your pain and get you back to the life you love.

Our board certified physicians and advanced practice providers take a comprehensive and
rehabilitative approach to pain and offer a wide range of interventional and minimally invasive
surgical treatments to heal chronic pain. 

At Southern Pain and Spine, we are pleased to bring a premier level of minimally-invasive spine and
joint pain care to metro Atlanta, North Georgia, and beyond. If you’re ready to take the first step
toward reducing pain and improving function, we’re here to help.

How it works

## Stopain products are formulated for powerful pain relief with 8% Menthol
* **Cooling Sensation That Eases Pain Fast**
  This effect, known as counterirritation, helps distract the brain from pain signals and delivers
  immediate relief.
* **Blocking Pain Signals at the Nerve Level**
  Beyond providing a cooling effect, menthol actually interacts with pain receptors in the body,
  blocking the transmission of pain signals.
* **Enhancing Blood Flow **
  When applied to sore muscles or stiff joints, menthol stimulates blood flow, which helps to reduce
  inflammation, loosen stiff joints (ideal for arthritis relief), and improve mobility.
